acceptance: Research master plan defines falsifiable research questions, hypotheses, baselines, publication gates, safety scope, and paper-ready criteria
Architecture document preserves multiple candidate model families and does not predeclare ECAL or any architecture as successful before ablation evidence
GAXBench specification covers action quality, calibration, abstention, evidence intervention, counterfactual sensitivity, FHIR, distribution shift, and systems efficiency
Data governance prevents PHI publication, records licensing/provenance, freezes entity-disjoint splits before transformations, and forbids test-derived training or calibration
Reproducibility policy binds every public numeric claim to immutable revisions, commands, seeds, hardware, raw metrics, and failure counts
Literature map covers Jev, CLM, Laya, decider, open one-pass baselines, BioClinical ModernBERT, MedAgentBench, FHIR-AgentBench, Med-PRM, and MedQAbstain
Publication plan defines arXiv plus peer-review path without promising unverified venue deadlines or acceptance
Apache-2.0 code license is present while model/data licenses remain independently governed
No implementation or benchmark SOTA claim is introduced in the foundation grain
Foundation PR is reviewable as a bounded planning-only change

minimality.rationale: The repository was empty. The minimal safe first grain is a research contract and evidence/benchmark governance before any implementation or training.

requirements: Do not present GAX as a medical device or autonomous clinical decision maker.
Do not publish PHI or restricted source text.
Do not add performance or safety claims without artifact-backed matched evaluation.

unresolved_decisions: Winning model architecture remains intentionally unresolved until P02/P03 matched experiments.
Final peer-reviewed venue remains unresolved until the final contribution and active calls are verified.

verification: manuscript contains no placeholder numerical result claims
README contains no performance or clinical-safety claim
no model weights, datasets, or PHI were introduced

outcome: Freeze the evidence-first research foundation for GAX: literature position, falsifiable hypotheses, architecture search, benchmark contract, data governance, reproducibility discipline, roadmap, and publication gates before implementation.
rationale: GAX is a greenfield health-AI research repository. Starting with code before defining leakage, calibration, abstention, evidence, FHIR, and publication gates would risk producing an impressive demo without a defensible paper. SG-000001 therefore authorizes planning artifacts only.

risk.recovery: Revert the foundation branch and return to the single README initialization commit. No model weights, datasets, or production behavior are changed by this grain.

scope_in: Architecture search space and ECAL as an explicitly unproven working objective
GAXBench evaluation design and statistical protocol
Data licensing, provenance, leakage, PHI, and counterfactual governance
Program roadmap from benchmark kernel through external validation
title: GAX-P00 - Research foundation and publication contract
